find:
stroke(border, tk.border.casing, tk.border.casingAlpha, tk.border.casingWidth);
  stroke(coast, tk.coast.casing, tk.coast.casingAlpha, tk.coast.casingWidth);
note: DESIGN-SPEC 4.4: the casing under the core is what keeps a line legible over the deepest band (core alone is 1.85:1 on the deepest blue). Removing both casing strokes must fail S-LINEART where the field is dark (Paper, field on).
